This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
#plotting number of DMRs with updated results

library(readxl)
full_DMRs <- read_excel("updated_DMRs.xlsx")
full_DMRs

library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
CG <- full_DMRs %>%
  filter(Context == "CG")

CG
filter_CG <- CG %>%
  select (Context, Sample, Gain_DMR, Loss_DMR)

melted_CG <- melt(filter_CG, id=c("Sample", "Context"))



CHG <- full_DMRs %>%
  filter(Context == "CHG")

filter_CHG <- CHG %>%
  select (Context, Sample, Gain_DMR, Loss_DMR)
melted_CHG <- melt(filter_CHG, id=c("Sample", "Context"))


CHH <- full_DMRs %>%
  filter(Context == "CHH")
filter_CHH <- CHH %>%
  select (Context, Sample, Gain_DMR, Loss_DMR)
melted_CHH <- melt(filter_CHH, id=c("Sample", "Context"))

```


```{r}
#make bar graphs 

library(ggplot2)

context <- "CHH"

sample_order <- c("gen2_drdd", "4-1_R0_", "4-2_R0_", "4-2_R1_", "4-14_R0_", "4-15_R0_", "4-3_R0_", "4-4_R0_", "4-4_R1_", "4-11_R0_")

p<-ggplot(data=melted_CHH, 
          aes(x=factor(Sample, sample_order), y=value, fill=variable)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position=position_dodge()) + 
  ylab(paste0("Number of ", context, " DMRs")) + xlab("") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0(context, " DMRs"))+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F5B085","#51D0C1"))

p + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1))

ggsave(paste0(context, "_DMRs_updated.png"), width = 5, height = 3)

```

When you save the notebook, an HTML file containing the code and output will be saved alongside it (click the *Preview* button or press *Cmd+Shift+K* to preview the HTML file).
